purpose: Coordinate one recoverable agent-work loop without becoming a second Fact, Episode, Mission, Xinfa, or review authority.

corePublicAdapters: Fact identity, immutable versions, relations, Cuts, refs, CAS, and receipts
Episode begin, attach, seal, abort, inspect, and replay
Profile action admission and authority receipts
existingAuthorities: Work Control owns Initiative, Assignment, Completion Claim, assessment, independent review, and continuation
Xinfa owns Atlas compile, verify, projection, and successor context
Project Cut owns source, Atlas, Episode-delta, and publication settlement
forbidden: Action MJS reads or writes private journal, CAS, runtime, or storage layouts
Action MJS mints Fact, Episode, Profile, Mission, Go, review, continuation, or Project Cut receipts
A compatibility adapter becomes a second source of truth
External Git, provider, and runtime effects are represented as one rollback-capable transaction

roles.compatibilitySource: Mission/Go exact subject and acceptance root
verified Xinfa Atlas and Project Cut context binding

factRef.cas: exact expected-old cut root and revision
factRef.newRef: expected-old root is null and revision is zero

envelope.roleBindingRule: Every role identity and root is explicit; no role is inferred from another role, current chat, current process, or current workspace.
envelope.episodeRootRule: episodeRoot is null only before Episode seal; sealed and later states require an exact root.
envelope.projectionRule: The envelope is a rebuildable projection over accepted authority receipts, not an authority record.
envelope.nativeAuthorityRule: A native agent entry records one aggregate root over the loaded binding identity and active Work Control Profile exact root; resume and settle fail closed if either changes.

checkpoint.rule: A checkpoint records observed roots and allowed recovery actions; it cannot promote transcript, process exit, or Agent self-report to completion proof.

stepReceipt.authorityRule: The receiptRoot must be returned by the public adapter named by the step, bind the canonical adapter receipt preimage including authorityReceiptRoot, and pass root verification; the coordinator cannot mint or rewrite it.

orderedSteps.idempotency: same key and same accepted receipt is reuse; different receipt is conflict
resume the exact open Episode; never open a second Episode for the same key
reuse the exact sealed root; mismatched open/sealed state is refused
reuse an exactly verified successor Atlas; changed sources require a successor binding
reuse the exact independent review root; pending or non-fit review does not settle
same expected-old and successor Cut is reuse; stale expected-old writes nothing

writes: verified Atlas through Xinfa public surface

ports.compatibility: explicit goal authority material; ownership alone is insufficient

reads: five explicit role identities and roots
writes: KFD-7 Profile transitions through the public Profile adapter
Episode begin, attach, seal, abort, and reconcile through the public lifecycle

reads: completion claim, assessment, evidence availability, and exact roots
writes: Work Control claim, independent review, and continuation receipts

reads: current named ref and expected-old revision
writes: native Fact versions, relations, Cut, CAS ref move, and kernel receipt

typedResults.effect: continue from the next missing accepted step
return the existing settlement receipt without mutation
obtain an explicit identity/root; do not infer it
compile and verify a successor Atlas before continuing
stop the requested action; revocation is not retryable
read the current Fact ref and re-plan; no write occurred
inspect the exact Episode and reconcile or refuse
resume from the first missing accepted step
do not retry blindly; compare the accepted receipt and external effect
inspect the external system and record compensation or acceptance
rebuild the projection from accepted receipts
reselect one native binding and reconcile its Profile exact root before resuming; no write occurred

settlement.completionRule: A sealed Episode, process exit, Project Cut, transcript, or Agent assertion alone cannot complete the Pursuit.
settlement.externalEffects: Each external effect has its own accepted receipt, retry rule, and compensation status.

nonClaims: This v0 internal contract does not freeze public CLI, API, GUI, or Profile names.
This contract does not implement begin, resume, settlement, or source dogfood by itself.
This contract does not qualify P17, FO9, FO10, or an official artifact.
Compatibility mappings are replacement seams, not native Pursuit, Atlas, or Warrant implementations.
